title: Navigating Nuance: In Quest for Political Truth

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying text statements from the Media Bias Identification Benchmark (MBIB) as politically biased or unbiased using the Llama-3 (70B) language model. The evaluation compares the effectiveness of zero-shot, few-shot, and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting strategies, using the Macro-F1 score to measure classification performance.
